resources.string: Skip setup. You can run it again from Settings.
A keyboard for Amharic, Tigrinya, Afaan Oromoo and English. Setup takes about a minute.
Typing works fully offline. You do not need an account to type.
What you type stays on your device. The keyboard hands it only to the app you are typing in; it does not store it or send it anywhere.
This version has no AI features. If they are added, they will be optional and will run only when you ask for them.
Your keyboard settings are stored on this device.
Read the full privacy notice in your browser
Android needs you to switch Qal Smart Keyboard on in the system keyboard list. Tap the button, turn on Qal Smart Keyboard, then come back here.
Qal Smart Keyboard is turned on.
Qal Smart Keyboard is not turned on yet.
Android shows a general warning that any keyboard can see what you type. The privacy notice in the first step says what this keyboard does.
Now pick Qal Smart Keyboard as the keyboard you type with. Tap the button and choose it in the list that appears.
Qal Smart Keyboard is your current keyboard.
Choose the languages you type in. The first one is used when the keyboard opens; the globe key moves to the next language in this order. You can change this later in Settings.
How do you want to type %1$s?
Type with Latin letters, for example selam, and get ሰላም.
Tap a consonant, then a vowel key.
Tap the box and type. If the keyboard does not appear, go back and choose Qal Smart Keyboard.
Type here to try the keyboard
Qal Smart Keyboard is not your current keyboard, so the box below will use another one.
Phonetic: type selam and tap the word on the strip above the keys (or press space) to get ሰላም.
Fidel grid: tap a consonant, then a vowel key. Or long-press a consonant and slide to the form you want.
Globe key: tap to go to the next language.
Globe key: long-press to switch between the layouts of the current language (for example phonetic, Fidel and ABC).
ABC key: switches to plain Latin letters and back.
Space bar: long-press to pick a language from a list.
Punctuation: while typing in Amharic or Tigrinya, long-press . or , for ። ፣ ፤ and more.
Words marked DRAFT come from language data that is still being reviewed.
Turn on and choose the keyboard, pick languages and try it out.
Changes apply to the keyboard right away.
Choose how the keyboard looks. Tap a theme to see a larger preview; nothing changes until you tap Apply.
Premium themes are included with Premium. You can preview all of them.
Classic Light or Classic Dark, following your phone.
This is only a preview. Your keyboard keeps its current theme until you apply this one.
Sign in to use Premium themes that belong to your account.
Your plan does not include Premium themes.
Connect to the internet once so we can check your plan.
Words you add or the keyboard learns as you type. They stay on this device, encrypted, and are never uploaded. Nothing is learned in password fields or when a field asks for no personalised learning.
All added and learned words and word pairs, in every language, are deleted from this device. This cannot be undone.
You do not need an account to type. Sign in only if you want account features when they arrive; you can do this later in Settings.
Tap Continue to skip this step.

Keep the words you added or the keyboard learned on all your devices. Words are encrypted on our servers and decrypted only to deliver them to your devices over a secure connection. You can turn this off at any time.
Sign in with your phone number or Google account to sync your dictionary. Guest sessions cannot.
Could not update this setting. Check your connection and try again.
You are not signed in. Typing works without an account.
You were signed out because your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
You are using a guest session. Sign in to keep it.
You will be signed out on this device. The keyboard keeps working.
Ethiopian numbers can be typed with or without +251. For another country start with + and the country code.
I confirm that I am old enough to create an account where I live.
A guest session needs no phone number or Google account. This device is checked once to make sure the app is genuine.
You are using a guest session. If you sign in, your guest data is kept.
We sent a %1$d-digit code by SMS to %2$s.
You can ask for a new code in %1$d s.
You are using a guest session.
Your guest data was kept: this guest session is now your account.
Your guest data was kept: it was added to your existing account.
That does not look like a valid phone number. Check it and try again.
Enter an Ethiopian mobile number: 09… or 07…, or +251 9… or +251 7….
That code is not right. Check it and try again.
That code has expired. Ask for a new code.
Too many wrong codes. Ask for a new code.
Too many tries. Please wait and try again.
Too many tries. Please try again in %1$d s.
Please confirm the age statement above to create an account.
This account cannot sign in right now. Contact support if you think this is a mistake.
No connection. Check your internet and try again.
The server took too long to answer. Try again.
Google sign-in is not available on this device or build.
Google sign-in did not work. Try again or use your phone number.
Google sign-in was not accepted. Try again or use your phone number.
Google sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later or use your phone number.
A guest session could not be started on this device. Sign in with your phone number instead.
Guest sessions are not available on this device or build.
Your session ended. Please try again.
This version of Qal Smart Keyboard is too old to talk to the server. Typing still works; update to sign in and use online features.
Plans and upgrades will be available here soon. Typing and the on-device features keep working in the meantime.
See what stays on your phone and what is sent, and manage your consents, saved AI history, data export and account deletion.
You are not signed in, so we hold no account data about you. Sign in, or continue as a guest, to see and change what is stored on your account.
You are using a guest session. You can export or delete its data. Dictionary sync is only for accounts with a phone number or Google sign-in.
Everything you type. Keystrokes and drafts are never sent, logged or used for statistics.
Your personal dictionary, unless you turn on dictionary sync, and your keyboard settings.
Typing works fully offline and needs no account.
Only when you tap an AI action: the text of that action, and nothing else. It is processed and not stored, unless you turned on AI history.
If you have an account or guest session: your account, your settings and your consent decisions. Dictionary words are sent only if you turn on dictionary sync.
Your content is never used to train AI models and never sold or shared for advertising.
You can download a copy of the data we hold about you, or delete your account. Deleting keeps a 14-day window to change your mind.
Your account is scheduled for deletion on %1$s.
Send crash reports — no typed text, ever

If the app or the keyboard crashes, we receive the technical details: the kind of error, where in our code it happened, the app version, and the phone model and Android version. Never what you typed, your clipboard, AI text, screenshots or your phone number. It works without an account.
Each choice below is optional and can be changed at any time. Changing it takes effect at once, and every decision is recorded.
This cannot be withdrawn. To stop, delete your account.
Every decision you made, oldest first. Records are never changed; withdrawing adds a new record.
You accepted the terms of use when you created your account.
You accepted the privacy notice when you created your account.
Lets the keyboard send the text of an AI action you tap (translate, fix grammar, rewrite) to our servers and AI providers to produce the result. Providers may not train on it.
AI actions stop working until you allow this again. Typing is not affected.
Saves the text and result of your AI actions, encrypted, so you can find them again. Off by default. You choose how long it is kept.
New AI results are no longer saved. Items already saved stay until you delete them in AI history.
Lets AI results follow your own writing style.
Your writing style is no longer used for AI results.
Lets us keep the comments you write when you rate an AI result, to improve quality.
Comments you wrote about AI results are deleted from our servers now. Your ratings stay, without any text.
Lets you contribute words and corrections that help improve language support for everyone.
Nothing more is contributed from your account after this.
Lets us keep voice recordings from voice features. Audio is never kept by default.
Voice recordings are no longer kept after this.
Lets us count which features are used, without any text you type.
Usage statistics are no longer collected from you.
Lets us contact you about new features and offers.
You will no longer get news and offers.
Needed for recurring payments. You give it when you set up a payment, and you manage it with your payments.
Withdrawing it cancels the payment mandates that depend on it.
When this is on, the results of your AI actions are saved on our servers, encrypted, so you can find them later. Off by default.
Turning it on records your consent to save AI history. Turning it off stops saving and withdraws that consent. Items already saved stay until you delete them below.
Your plan does not include history, so nothing will be saved until you have a plan that does.
History is saved only while the consent for it is allowed. Check the consents screen.
Items are deleted automatically after %1$d days. Favourites are kept until you remove them.
Favourite: kept until you remove it
Every saved item is deleted from our servers, favourites included. This cannot be undone.
Prepare a copy of the data we hold about you. It can take a few minutes. You can leave this screen and come back.

It includes your account, settings, consents, saved AI history, dictionary, devices, sessions, AI request records, feedback, usage, credits, subscriptions and receipts, as one JSON file. You can ask for up to 3 exports in 24 hours.
An export is already being prepared, so no new one was started.
This screen checks again every few seconds.
The download is available until %1$s, then it is deleted.
The saved file is not protected by our servers. Anyone who can open it can read your data, so keep it somewhere safe.
The file was saved where you chose.
The last export expired. Request a new one.
You asked for the most exports allowed. You can ask again after %1$s.
This deletes your account and everything stored on our servers: settings, saved history, synced dictionary and profiles. Records we must keep by law are kept without your identity.
You have 14 days to change your mind. AI features stop at once. After 14 days the deletion is final and your data cannot be recovered.
On this device you are signed out and the account data cached here is removed. Typing, your languages and your personal dictionary stay.
This is a guest session. It stays signed in on this device so you can cancel, because a guest cannot sign in again.
After the 14 days it is gone. You can still export during the 14 days.
You were signed out on this device. To cancel, sign in again with the same phone number or Google account before that date, then open Privacy and Delete my account.
You still have a store subscription. Cancel it in the store, or you will keep being charged.
Your account will be deleted on %1$s.
Until then you can cancel and keep your account. AI features are switched off.
The deletion has started and can no longer be cancelled.
Sign in to delete your account or to cancel a deletion you asked for. If you never had an account, nothing is stored about you on our servers.
No connection. Check your network and try again.
That took too long. Try again.
You are signed out. Sign in again.
Too many requests. Try again later.
Too many requests. Try again in %1$s.
This consent cannot be withdrawn. Delete your account to stop.
This needs a consent you have not given.
Your account is already being deleted.
This is not available for your account right now.
The file could not be saved there. Choose another place.
Type the word shown to confirm.
